league.name: H-Town Heroes
league.scoring: Full PPR, 6-point passing TD, -1 INT, +3 at 300 passing, +2 at 100 rushing/receiving

caveats: This is a reconstruction of today's model architecture, not the exact code that existed before either season.
Only archived preseason ECR/ADP and prior-season NFL evidence enter each replay; outcome-season stats are isolated until evaluation.
Availability-adjusted results use 17-game pace for players with at least six stat-active games. They do not claim every missed game was an injury.
Historical rookie college and preseason Vegas snapshots are not yet complete, so rookies stay closer to archived market priors in v1.
Three seasons are directional evidence, not enough to prove a durable predictive edge.

rosterSimulation.recommendation: No middle-round authority factor cleared the two-of-three held-out gate; keep the current ranking order in production.

tuningSuggestions.title: Keep the core model-versus-market blend
tuningSuggestions.evidence: The model beat stock correlation in both outcome views in 3 of 3 seasons.
tuningSuggestions.recommendation: Do not broadly reweight VOR, prior usage, or market anchoring from this test.

tuningSuggestions.title: Keep Target as the primary positive draft call
tuningSuggestions.evidence: 51 Targets beat their stock rank 57% of the time with positive average rank surplus in 2 of 3 seasons.
tuningSuggestions.recommendation: Use Target as the actionable positive label while preserving its current selectivity.

tuningSuggestions.title: Retire the legacy static Smash label
tuningSuggestions.evidence: 22 Smash calls averaged -36.1 ranks versus cost and were positive in 0 of 3 seasons.
tuningSuggestions.recommendation: Display Target before the draft. Allow Smash Now only after the live room supplies a validated price fall, urgent survival risk, and usable roster fit.

tuningSuggestions.title: Keep TE changes in shadow mode
tuningSuggestions.evidence: TE produced a -0.007 realized correlation edge and beat stock in 1 of 3 seasons.
tuningSuggestions.recommendation: Do not restore blanket TE value. Test route participation and TPRR only when complete historical coverage exists.

tuningSuggestions.title: Complete historical rookie inputs before tuning rookies
tuningSuggestions.evidence: Archived ECR/ADP are complete, but comparable preseason college-production, team-situation, and Vegas yardage snapshots are not.
tuningSuggestions.recommendation: Keep rookies market-anchored in this backtest and build a separate rookie validation lane rather than inferring a rookie weight from veteran results.

tuningSuggestions.title: Gate stronger middle-round authority on roster outcomes
tuningSuggestions.evidence: No middle-round authority factor cleared the two-of-three held-out gate; keep the current ranking order in production.
tuningSuggestions.recommendation: Keep the current acquisition order; use the value-pocket queue as context rather than a rank multiplier.
